description: Run a calc or analysis case once per row of the ranges given (%sweep), or over rows drawn from them (%samples), and return the table: each row's inputs, outputs, verdicts and timing. The verdict holds when every run completed and every objective was satisfied.

arguments.description: argument expressions fixed for every row, positional or parameter=expression

name.description: qualified name of the calc or analysis case

object.description: the case's subject, an object the session holds

ranges.description: one per swept parameter, written parameter=from..to[:step]; the rows are the cartesian product

samples.description: draw rows uniformly from the ranges instead of stepping them

seed.description: the same seed draws the same rows

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

name: sweep

tied.description: passed over for one evaluating alike

rows.description: one per run of a sweep or of repeated runs

error.description: what stopped the run when it failed

tied.description: passed over for one evaluating alike

status.description: holds, fails or unresolved; unresolved is a question the model did not answer (an unknown name, a run that could not be made)

subject.description: what was run or checked, as named

values.description: what the run produced: a calc's result, an action's outputs, a case's outputs and verdicts
